name: Ccache for gh actions
description: A GitHub Action that speeds up compiling for C/C++ projects using ccache.

key.description: An additional key for the cache

restore-keys.description: An ordered list of keys to use for restoring the cache if no cache hit occurred for key

restore.description: Flag for if you should restore cache or not, useful for generating clean cache.

verbose.description: Verbosity level: 0 (default), 1 or 2. Ignore for sccache.

variant.description: Ccache variant to use. Either "ccache" (the default) or "sccache" (see https://github.com/mozilla/sccache)

save.description: If 'false', do not save the cache, only restore.

append-timestamp.description: Append a timestamp to the cache key (default: true)

create-symlink.description: If set to 'true', create symlinks for ccache in /usr/local/bin to override default toolchains

job-summary.description: Publish stats as part of the job summary. Set to the title of the job summary section, or to the empty string to disable this feature. Requires CCache 4.10+

evict-old-files.description: Corresponds to the ccache --evict-older-than AGE option, where AGE is the number of seconds or days followed by the 's' or 'd' suffix respectively. Also support

update-package-index.description: Update package manager index before installing ccache. Enabling this might help when running ccache-action in a container or from `act`. Disabling this might sp

install.description: Whether or not to install ccache automatically. Options: - yes: forcefully install through the package manager if available, or fall back to a binary - binary:
